status: next-hypothesis-design-only; no fitted player effect or ROI claim
question: Does a verified change in player availability or workload add predictive value beyond the same-time market and a no-fact baseline?
policy: Separate a tipster's directional opinion from a factual claim; an opinion is not official confirmation.
Both the claim and confirmation must have been received by the real decision at or before T-30.
Use prior completed boxscores for bullpen workload; never use target-game pitches or final score.
Missing earlier expected lineup or quote remains unknown, never zero or an invented earlier snapshot.
Match player and product identity independently of the result; distinguish probable from confirmed.
Store actual bytes and witness provenance where available; a URL, hash field or timestamp assertion is not authentication.
A before/after quote sequence alone does not establish a causal price effect or an executable edge.
Learn and freeze effect coefficients on eligible earlier data before comparing predictions; never hand-add probability bonuses.
Compare market, exact frozen operating selection, no-fact model and fact model on identical fixtures, prices, settlement and coverage.
No new model adoption, retrospective freeze rewrite, production schedule or paper-wallet change is enabled by this design.
